dict.string: PIN AI uses Bluetooth to detect nearby devices and beacons that hint at the place you’re in, so it can build a richer activity timeline. No data is sent to other devices.
PIN AI reads your calendar to weave upcoming meetings and events into your daily timeline. Calendar contents stay on your device unless you explicitly enable sync.
PIN AI reads your contacts only when you ask it to look up a person by name. Contact details stay on your device unless you explicitly enable a contacts-aware feature.
PIN AI reads health metrics (steps, heart rate, sleep) you’ve already saved in Apple Health to add context to your daily timeline. No health data is shared with third parties.
PIN AI may write back health summaries it derives so they’re available alongside the rest of your Apple Health data. Writes happen only when you confirm them.
PIN AI uses your location to detect place arrivals/departures even when the app is in the background, so it can keep your timeline up to date.
PIN AI uses your location to detect place visits and provide context-aware suggestions.
PIN AI uses the microphone to classify ambient sounds (e.g. speech, music, traffic) so it can build your daily timeline. Audio is processed on-device and only short labels are uploaded.
PIN AI uses motion data to detect your current activity (walking, running, driving) for context-aware suggestions.
PIN AI saves images it generates (e.g. shared cards) into your Photos library when you tap “Save”. No automatic writes.
PIN AI reads photos only when you pick one to attach to a chat or memory. Photos stay on your device until you explicitly upload one.
PIN AI uses on-device speech recognition to create local transcript drafts from short ambient audio captures.
